INSERT INTO negotiation.document_renditions (document_id, asset_id, request_id)
         VALUES ($1, $2, $3)
         ON CONFLICT (document_id) DO UPDATE
            SET asset_id = EXCLUDED.asset_id,
                request_id = EXCLUDED.request_id,
                status = 'pending',
                page_count = NULL,
                outline = NULL,
                is_reflowable = NULL,
                quality = NULL,
                reading_bytes = NULL,
                extractor = NULL,
                failure_reason = NULL,
                extracted_at = NULL
